paragraph_checks.label: Macro Stance
paragraph_checks.reviewed_text: The US soft-landing case has a more useful policy endorsement, but it still lacks permission to assume immediate easing. Barron's reports Powell seeing inflation progress while requiring more confidence before cutting rates; the Hill likewise reports progress that is insufficient for a cut. [[n2432]] [[n2436]] This favours patience with high-quality cash generation and a measured duration allocation. It leaves a harder question for businesses that need rapid relief in customers' financing costs. A falling inflation rate can help real purchasing power, yet the passage from that improvement to cheaper borrowing and then stronger sales may be uneven. The investment bridge should identify which stage supports each holding.

Watch commitments to productive projects and profitable customer demand before inferring an effective credit impulse from the direction of government bonds.
